thread:
ana_cs: FYI BetaCo cutover to prod and customers saw short 429 bursts on SDK init/embed calls ~15m after switch. Bursts last ~20-40s then stop.

leo_sdk: Do we have client error payloads and any `x-rw-rate` headers?

ana_cs: Client shows `{"error":"rate_limited","code":429}`. Server logs show `WARN auth: throttled ip=34.80.12.45 route=/v1/sdk/init` repeated.

owen_platform: Likely ephemeral egress (cloud NAT) + lots of short-lived connections. If they're creating clients per request that will spike per-ip token usage.

marta_infra: BetaCo confirmed they scaled frontend pods and use cloud NAT. Makes sense.

leo_sdk: Common anti-pattern: instantiating per-request. Ask for their code. Recommend module-scoped client + keepAlive + limit concurrency.

ana_cs: They sent this: `export default async function(req){ const c = new RedwoodClient({key:K}); await c.init(); /* per request */ }`

leo_sdk: Yep. Advise: create client once at module load, use keepAlive=true, set maxConcurrentRequests=6, backoff with jitter. Example snippet provided.

owen_platform: I'll apply a 10m tenant burst override while they fix: `tenant:betaco-01 window:30s burst:+120`.

marta_infra: Applied. Deploy-bot: rate-policy updated for tenant betaco-01 by marta_infra at 2026-03-21T15:12:04Z.

ana_cs: BetaCo redeployed with client fix. Errors dropped to near-zero.

leo_sdk: Follow-ups: add onboarding note about client reuse, surface `x-rw-rate` in SDK logs, consider a diagnostic flag that logs rate headers.

owen_platform: I'll add the checklist item and file a tiny infra postmortem about the temporary override.

ana_cs: Thanks everyone. Will monitor 24h then close. :white_check_mark:
